value.message: Cartwheels Gym Centre runs Tiny Gym for 1 (walking) to 3 year olds with a caregiver, plus Rock n' Roll with Miss Kelly for 0+ - their Term 1 2026-27 schedule PDF lists both but not day/time or price yet. Registration opened Wed July 22 at 8am online. I'll keep watching and text you the exact times once they're posted.
